full_judgment: K. M. Subhan, J:- This petition is by the defendant appellant against whom a suit was filed for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession. The learned Munsif dismissed the suit but on appeal the lower appellate court reversed the finding of the learned Munsif and decreed the suit. A learned single judge of the then High Court summarily dismissed the second appeal at the time of civil procedure holding that the learned sub-ordinate judge had reversed the findings with proper reasonings with which the learned single judge also agreed.
